title: Scaling Sentinel: Rate Adjustor & Throughput Chronicle (Console Fleet Controls)
creator: Avery Chen
description: Objective: Ship a cohesive Fleet Controls surface in the Console that lets operators set throughput guarantees, author autoscaling policies, and inspect an immutable change history. This ticket focuses on the operator-facing pieces: the rate adjustor control (instant and scheduled), an at-a-glance throughput dashboard for fleet-level headroom/SLOs, and a chronological change ledger that links to rollout actions and telemetry. Scope excludes backend autoscaler engines (ENG ownership) but includes API contracts, control UX, telemetry hooks, and rollback affordances.
acceptance_criteria: Console UI exposes a Rate Adjustor widget allowing: live throttle sliders (qps/token throughput), schedule-based overrides, and a confirmation modal showing estimated cost delta.
Autoscaling policy editor available in Console with support for target-based and thresholds-based policies, saving to policy config v2 and returning policy ID.
Throughput dashboard shows 1h/24h/7d throughput heatmap, current committed capacity, estimated headroom, and SLO compliance indicator (green/amber/red).

Change history stores immutable entries for any change to fleet capacity/policy: who, when, before/after, linked rollout or dashboard snapshot; entries are searchable and filterable by actor, type, and time window.
All UI actions create telemetry events (user_id, fleet_id, action, spec) and a minimal rollback action is surfaced if a change causes SLO regressions.
Design sign-off and security checklist completed; e2e smoke test verifying rate adjustor application on a staging Dedicated fleet passes (observed in telemetry within 60s).
notes: Trade-offs: showing cost delta inline improves operator confidence but requires a cost-estimation service hook; initial implementation will show estimated delta using the coarse estimator from Optimize team; fine-grained billing integration will come later.
We intentionally keep autoscaling engine changes out of scope to avoid coupling releases; Console writes policy objects and the runtime picks them up via existing policy sync endpoints.
Accessibility: controls must be keyboard-navigable and have descriptive aria labels for slider and confirmation modal.
Rollout plan: feature flag + canary to 10% of org accounts, telemetry gating for SLO regressions before wider rollout.
Performance concern: throughput dashboard queries should use pre-aggregated telemetry views to avoid UI timeouts at large fleet scales.
updates: 2025-01-28 - Kickoff: PM aligned with Design and Eng. Drafted PRD and identified two backend APIs required from ENG (policy-create, policy-list + history append).
2025-02-04 - Design exploratory: Figma mocks for Rate Adjustor and Change Ledger completed (see link). Feedback: reduce modal friction and add inline examples for scheduled overrides.
2025-02-11 - Eng sync: ENG-3124 agreed to expose a 'policy-preview' endpoint to compute estimated throughput headroom and cost delta. Dependency added: ENG-3124.
2025-02-18 - Prototype: Frontend prototype implemented for slider with simulated backend. UX testing with 3 platform engineers; discovered need for 'preview' snapshot before commit.

2025-02-25 - Security review kickoff: scoped data surfaced in change history minimized (no raw tokens, only policy IDs and diffs). Security flagged requirement to redact user email in audit log for external contractors.
2025-03-01 - QA: Began smoke tests on staging fleet; observed policy-list pagination bug with >1k policies; filed ENG-3199.
comments: Design review (2025-02-06) - Maya Patel: Prefer explicit 'Apply & Monitor' flow instead of immediate apply for scheduled overrides. Suggest adding a 'simulate impact' button.
Engineering review (2025-02-12) - Jamal Ortiz: Backend API will accept policy spec v2. Need a mapping document for fields that are runtime-only vs UI-only; added to links.
PM follow-up (2025-02-20) - Avery Chen: Added acceptance criteria for rollback affordance; Eng to propose a 'revert to previous policy' API or support manual rollback via change-history entry link.
Security (2025-02-26) - Anika Rao: Audit entries must include a correlation_id for tracing and must not store secrets; acknowledged and added to telemetry contract.
change_history_summary: Immutable ledger of capacity and policy changes; each entry captures actor, timestamp, delta (before/after), linked rollout/PR, and a pointer to the telemetry snapshot used for SLO calculations. Ledger supports filtering by user/actor, policy type, and date range.
implementation_notes: Frontend: React components for slider, schedule editor, and ledger table; ledger rows link to a 'snapshot' view that queries precomputed telemetry endpoints.

Backend: policy-create writes to PolicyStore and appends human-readable diff to ChangeLedger service; policy-preview calls CostEstimator and TelemetryAggregator to return headroom and estimated token-cost delta.
Monitoring: create a Grafana panel for 'Recent Fleet Policy Changes' with links to replay telemetry for the 30 minutes after each change.
